description: Überschwemmungsgebiete Sachsen-Anhalt is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. According to § 76 WHG, floodplains are areas between above-ground waters and dikes or high banks and other areas that are flooded or flowed through in the event of floods in above-ground waters or that are claimed for flood relief or retention. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplains of Saxony-Anhalt" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2022-04-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
